**Job description** 





 We are looking to hire a talented iOS developer to design, build, and maintain the next generation of iOS applications. Your primary focus will be developing high\-end iOS applications for the latest Apple mobile devices. Your duties may include collaborating with the design team for new application features, identifying and fixing application bottlenecks, maintaining the core code, and updating applications published on the App Store.
 





 To ensure success as an iOS developer, you should have a strong working knowledge of iOS Frameworks, be proficient in Objective\-C, and be able to work as part of a team. Ultimately, an outstanding iOS developer should be able to create functional, attractive applications that perfectly meet the needs of the user.
 




**Responsibilities** 



* Designing and building mobile applications for Apple’s iOS platform.
* Collaborating with the design team to define app features.
* Ensuring quality and performance of the application to specifications.
* Identifying potential problems and resolving application bottlenecks.
* Fixing application bugs before the final release.
* Publishing applications on App Store.
* Maintaining the code and atomization of the application.
* Designing and implementing application updates.



**Requirements** 



* Proficient in Objective\-C, Swift, and Cocoa Touch.
* Extensive experience with iOS Frameworks such as Core Data and Core Animation.
* Knowledge of iOS back\-end services and MVVM architecture
* Knowledge of Apple’s design principles and application interface guidelines.
* Proficient in code versioning tools including Mercurial, Git, and SVN.
* Knowledge of C\-based libraries.
* Familiarity with push notifications, APIs, and cloud messaging.
* Experience with continuous integration.

title: Flutter Bug-Fixing Expert
description:
We are looking for an experienced Flutter developer to troubleshoot and fix critical issues in an existing live audio calling app published on Google Play Store.
 



  





 Main Responsibilities:
 



  





 Fix ZEGOCLOUD call drops, call\-state and lifecycle issues
 



 Resolve FCM incoming\-call notifications in killed/background/locked states
 



 Synchronize Flutter app, Node.js backend, WebSocket/Socket.IO call states
 



 Handle Android background services, lock screen and poor\-network scenarios
 



 Fix audio routing, microphone, speaker, earpiece and Bluetooth issues
 



 Analyze Crashlytics and Logcat errors and implement stable fixes
 



  





 Required Skills:
 



  





 Strong Flutter debugging and asynchronous programming experience
 



 Production experience with ZEGOCLOUD, Agora or WebRTC
 



 Android/iOS background and native integration knowledge
 



 Node.js and real\-time signaling experience
 



 Ability to diagnose and deliver fast, production\-ready fixes
